req.title: Reject wrong method on /put
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than PUT on /put.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /put endpoint should only accept PUT requests and return a 405 Method Not Allowed for any other HTTP methods. This ensures that the endpoint adheres to the expected HTTP method constraints, preventing misuse or unexpected behavior.

tests.name: test_put_method_allowed
preconditions: The /put endpoint is available and configured to accept PUT requests.
actions: Send a PUT request to the /put endpoint.
expected: The response status code should be 200.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.put('/put', data={'key': 'value'})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'application/json' in response.content_type

tests.name: test_get_method_rejected
preconditions: The /put endpoint is available and configured to reject non-PUT requests.
actions: Send a GET request to the /put endpoint.
expected: The response status code should be 405.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/put')
assert response.status_code == 405
assert 'Method Not Allowed' in response.status

tests.name: test_post_method_rejected
preconditions: The /put endpoint is available and configured to reject non-PUT requests.
actions: Send a POST request to the /put endpoint.
expected: The response status code should be 405.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/put', data={'key': 'value'})
assert response.status_code == 405
assert 'Method Not Allowed' in response.status
